# Fightback: Consumer TV: do not block these
#
# Domains documented to break a television when blocked. Add them to your
# resolver's allowlist if you use a broad third-party list, because several
# popular lists include some of these.
#
# This list is the reason the project exists. A blocklist is easy. Knowing what
# not to block is the part that takes evidence.
#
# Entries: 73
# Updated: 2026-09-08
# Licence: CC0 1.0. Homepage: https://github.com/dgomesbr/fightback-consumer-tv
#
# Generated by tools/build_blocklists.py. Do not edit by hand.
#

# ---- amazon ----
# 2.android.pool.ntp.org
#   breaks: The clock drifts and certificate validation starts failing.
#   source: https://github.com/Perflyst/PiHoleBlocklist/blob/master/AmazonFireTV.txt
@@||2.android.pool.ntp.org^
# amazonadsi-a.akamaihd.net
#   breaks: App installation and updates fail.
#   source: https://github.com/Perflyst/PiHoleBlocklist/blob/master/AmazonFireTV.txt
@@||amazonadsi-a.akamaihd.net^
# amazonalexa.com
#   breaks: Alexa voice control stops working.
#   source: https://github.com/Perflyst/PiHoleBlocklist/blob/master/AmazonFireTV.txt
@@||amazonalexa.com^
# amazonaws.com
#   breaks: Wide collateral damage. Perflyst warns that device push messaging uses per-device certificates on shared AWS address space, so a blanket block takes out unrelated services.
#   source: https://github.com/Perflyst/PiHoleBlocklist/blob/master/SmartTV.txt
@@||amazonaws.com^
# api.amazon.com
#   breaks: The device stops working. PETS 2021 lists this as required, and it also appears on their non-required list because it multiplexes both kinds of traffic. Multiplexed hosts cannot be blocked at DNS level without collateral damage.
#   source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.05162
@@||api.amazon.com^
# ftv-smp.ntp-fireos.com
#   breaks: The clock drifts and certificate validation starts failing.
#   source: https://github.com/Perflyst/PiHoleBlocklist/blob/master/AmazonFireTV.txt
@@||ftv-smp.ntp-fireos.com^
# mas-ext.amazon.com
#   breaks: Apps cannot be installed.
#   source: https://github.com/Perflyst/PiHoleBlocklist/blob/master/AmazonFireTV.txt
@@||mas-ext.amazon.com^
# softwareupdates.amazon.com
#   breaks: Firmware updates fail.
#   source: https://github.com/Perflyst/PiHoleBlocklist/blob/master/AmazonFireTV.txt
@@||softwareupdates.amazon.com^
# unagi-eu.amazon.com
#   breaks: The device stops working. Classified required by PETS 2021.
#   source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.05162
@@||unagi-eu.amazon.com^

# ---- google ----
# android.apis.google.com
#   breaks: Device check-in and account sync fail.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||android.apis.google.com^
# connectivitycheck.android.com
#   breaks: The device decides it has no internet connection.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||connectivitycheck.android.com^
# connectivitycheck.gstatic.com
#   breaks: The device decides it has no internet connection and may refuse to work.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||connectivitycheck.gstatic.com^
# googleapis.com
#   breaks: Play Store, app updates, DRM licensing and sign-in all fail. The three platform telemetry hosts under this domain are listed individually above. Block those, not the parent.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||googleapis.com^
# gvt1.com
#   breaks: App downloads and updates fail.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||gvt1.com^
# ota.googlezip.net
#   breaks: System updates fail.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||ota.googlezip.net^
# play.google.com
#   breaks: The Play Store stops working.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||play.google.com^
# time.google.com
#   breaks: The clock drifts and certificate validation starts failing.
#   source: https://support.google.com/work/android/answer/10513641
@@||time.google.com^
